story: After several attempts, an 18-rider breakaway formed before the group split on the first climb, where Rota attacked solo. The reduced peloton eventually caught everyone. Pericas lost significant GC time after puncturing on the gravel sector. Guerin, Nych and Neves escaped on the final climb, with Guerin taking the victory.
